unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-PREP YEAR-LEVEL: B1 - THEME 10: CLASSROOM LIFE AND LEARNING WITH TECHNOLOGY

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students write and design a project on ''Technological Classroom Tools, Learning with Technology, and Future Classrooms.'' They will describe the ideal use of technology in the classroom, including the roles of students and teachers, the tools used, and the learning activities involved. They will write scripts for each role, showing how technology enhances learning and interaction. In the class, they will act out these roles, demonstrating how technology supports learning in a future classroom. The assignment will be evaluated by using rubrics. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''classroom life and learning with technology with its components such as technological classroom tools, learning with technology, future classrooms'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in the preparatory year of an upper secondary school may know what technological classroom tools, learning with technology, future classrooms mean in their own language as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in another language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in the preparatory year of an upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''classroom life and learning with technology'' in English from previous themes and/ or years such as ''a teacher, a student, a headmaster, a class, a classroom, internet, IT, to download, to study, to go to and so on'' and also some structures such as ''What should students do at school? They must study and learn. They will learn about technology in the school.'' in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in the preparatory year of an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''technological classroom tools, learning with technology, future classrooms'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a short picture -strip story could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the strip story in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To express opinions about future classroom technologies in English by using the target grammar. Activity 1: Future Tech Debate The teacher begins by explaining the activity and dividing students into two groups: supporters and sceptics of future classroom technologies. A statement is provided (e.g., ''In the future, students will be using AI tutors for all lessons''.), and students debate using the target grammar (e.g., Supporter: ''AI tutors will be helping students solve complex problems''. Sceptic: ''Students will be losing their creativity because of AI tutors''.). The debate is timed, and once it ends, the class evaluates the arguments using emoji cards to vote for the winning side. Both sides will be praised according to their performances. The teacher provides constructive feedback on language use, grammar, and debate strategies. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity. Objective: To practice describing future classroom technologies in a news-style presentation using their writing and speaking skills. Objective: To describe future classroom technologies in English by using the target vocabulary and the target grammar. Activity 2: Tech News Report Students work in pairs to create a short news report about a future classroom technology, using the target grammar (e.g., ''In 2035, teachers will be using holograms to explain science lessons. Students will be interacting with 3D models''.). They present their reports to the class, focusing on clear pronunciation while sharing ideas. The teacher provides constructive feedback on grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation. At the end of the activity, students’ reports are displayed on the classroom notice board. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To identify technological classroom tools, learning with technology, future classrooms in English by using the target vocabulary and the target grammar. Activity 1: Tech Match-Up The teacher prepares digital or physical cards with pictures of technological tools (e.g., VR headsets, tablets, smart boards) along with cards displaying their names. Students first match each technological tool with its correct name. After matching, they create sentences using the target vocabulary and grammar to describe how the tool will be used in the future (e.g., ''Students will be exploring ancient cities with VR headsets''.). The teacher provides feedback on grammar and pronunciation, ensuring the sentences are clear and correctly structured. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity. Objective: To talk about technological tools and their future uses in English for improving their listening and speaking skills by using the target grammar. Activity 2: Listen and Order The teacher provides visuals describing environments with technological tools used in the future and plays a listening text describing these environments. Students listen carefully and arrange the visuals in the order mentioned in the text. After sequencing the visuals, they describe the sequence using sentences in the target grammar (e.g., ''In the future, students will be programming robots''.). The teacher provides feedback on their grammar, pronunciation, and clarity of expression. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
